config.rationale: Extends the round-1 winner (res_cnn_base, 0.9875) by increasing depth 4→6 and hidden 64→96 to capture richer hierarchical local features at 28×28. The extra two residual blocks add capacity without over-parameterisation (96 channels × 6 blocks is still modest for 90k samples). LR reduced to 8e-4 for training stability at greater depth. Dropout raised to 0.25 to regularise the larger model. Brightness augmentation added (3rd augmentation) to counteract the very low channel stds (0.12–0.18) and expose the model to intensity variation. Weight decay nudged to 2e-4 for mild L2 regularisation. Cosine schedule and AdamW retained as the proven pair from round 1. Early stopping patience of 5 epochs gives the deeper network more room to converge before stopping.
